title: Zander C. Fuerza's "Masters of Deception" challenges the official narrative surrounding the 9/11 attacks
text:
Twenty-three years after the tragic events of Sept. 11, 2001, the world is still grappling with unanswered questions about the attacks and their aftermath. Zander C. Fuerza's book "Masters of Deception: Zionism, 9/11 and the War on Terror Hoax" adds fuel to the fire of an already contentious debate by suggesting that the official account of the attacks may be flawed, and that Israel and its supporters played a key role in orchestrating or exploiting the tragedy for geopolitical gain.
On that fateful day in 2001, the world watched as 19 hijackers, allegedly orchestrated by Osama bin Laden, carried out the deadliest terrorist attack in the history of the United States, destroying the Twin Towers of the World Trade Center and damaging the Pentagon, claiming nearly 3,000 lives.
The official narrative, as presented by the administration of former President George W. Bush and mainstream media, painted the attacks as a failure of intelligence and a horrifying act of terrorism. However, growing skepticism about this account has led some to question whether the truth is more complex — and potentially more sinister.
Fuerza’s book challenges the widely accepted version of events, arguing that the attacks were not just a tragic accident but a meticulously planned operation intended to further a geopolitical agenda.
Critics point to the rapid collapse of the Twin Towers, which some argue could only have been achieved through the use of explosives, and the role of thousands of architects and engineers who have come forward to dispute the official explanation.
The book also highlights the disproportionate influence of Zionist Jews in the media and government, suggesting that this influence was key to shaping the narrative and suppressing dissenting voices.
One of the most controversial aspects of the book is its assertion that Israel and its leaders were somehow complicit in the events of 9/11 or in exploiting them for political gain.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, speaking shortly after the attacks, famously stated that the tragedy was "good for Israel," predicting that it would strengthen U.S.-Israeli ties and shift public opinion in favor of Israel.
Other Israeli leaders echoed this sentiment, with some even likening the attacks to a "Hanukkah miracle" for the nation. Such remarks, along with the presence of Mossad agents in New Jersey hours after the attacks, have fueled speculation about Israel’s potential role.
The book also delves into the odd case of two Odigo employees who reportedly received warnings about the attacks hours before they occurred. While the full details of this case remain unclear, some have suggested that it points to Israeli foreknowledge of the attacks.
Additionally, the book argues that the U.S. government’s handling of the aftermath, including the release of Israeli suspects and the shutdown of certain investigations, was orchestrated by Zionist insiders to protect the official narrative and justify the so-called "War on Terror."
The War on Terror, according to Fuerza, was not just a response to 9/11 but a premeditated strategy driven by neoconservative Jews within the Bush administration who sought to reshape the Middle East in Israel’s favor. The book suggests that the attacks were used as a pretext for wars in Iraq and Afghanistan, as well as the ongoing push for military action against Iran.
While the book's claims are sure to spark controversy, they highlight a growing divide between those who accept the official narrative and those who believe that the truth about 9/11 is more complex — and potentially more troubling — than it seems. As the world reflects on the 20th anniversary of the attacks, Masters of Deception serves as a reminder that the events of September 11, 2001, may have been the catalyst for a much larger and more elusive geopolitical strategy.
The debate over 9/11's true nature is far from settled, and Fuerza's book is just one of many contributions to this ever-evolving conversation. Whether one accepts the book’s claims or not, it is clear that the events of September 11, 2001, continue to shape the world in ways that are still not fully understood. As we move forward, the need for critical thinking and an open-minded approach to history has never been more urgent.
